title: Six Paths Sage Mode
body:
Syntax: sixpaths [on|off|status]

Description: Ashura's level-75 reincarnate form. Toggle with sixpaths on/off. Activate for 40 Chakra; upkeep is 18 Chakra every ten idle seconds or 24 Chakra and 8 Stamina each combat round. At 0-100% mode mastery, gain 10-20% damage, 5-15% incoming damage reduction and +5-10 accuracy. Summon Sage Mode cannot stack with it. Paid maintenance trains mode mastery. Unlocks at level 75 only for Ashura reincarnations of any combat class. Costs 40 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 0 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
